scope: Editor selection and draft preservation during search, category switches, save refreshes, empty results and compact sidebars

before.replay: A temporary Node preload supplied the exact committed runtime source to the fixture without changing the worktree; helper files were unchanged; temporary preload removed

skipReason: Node/Rust archive interoperability requires VIENTO_TEST_ARCHIVE_BINARY; native archive code unchanged
controllerTestEnvironment: Actual search indexes/caches, filtering, custom category tab callbacks, index-loading, selection and editor/save controllers share a DOM fixture with in-memory files and controlled requests. Compact layouts use matchMedia simulation; metadata refresh checks the renderer argument rather than pixels. Save assertions verify path, revision, BOM/CRLF/trailing spaces and unrelated file content. Existing temporary HTTP tests also run in the full check.
